_comment: Which panel layout a Wii game starts with on a cabinet without a real Wii Remote (tools/Set-DolphinControllers.ps1). Key = the game's disc ID (6 characters). sideways = the remote held sideways (d-pad + 1 / 2), nunchuk = remote + nunchuk (stick moves, trackball points), classic = Classic Controller. A cabinet's own choices (Game Options > WII CONTROLS) are in <manifest>\wii-layouts.json and win.
